audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were marked Shen while whys[1] and whys[2] both say Nautilus out-trades you there; levels 4-5 and 6 were hedged 'Skill' while the prose says the lane flips fully in your favour at 4.
audit.why: Packet chart and the already-audited mirror agree on Skill, Nautilus, Nautilus, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen. Shen survives the hook levels then owns everything from Shadow Dash plus Spirit's Refuge onward.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 4 set as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Nautilus at 3 on the full combo, Shen at 4-5 when Spirit's Refuge plus Shadow Dash come together, Stand United at 6, tank item after. Depth Charge is 120/100/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid text says a missed hook leaves him helpless 'for the next eight seconds' — Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10s. wants.foe[1] had him building Duskblade into Locket, which is not a Nautilus build and describes no real interaction.
audit.why: Dredge Line (Q, 1150 range, 14s at rank 1) is the whole punish window and the real number is stronger advice. Depth Charge (R, 825 range, 120/100/80s) knocks up and stuns, and any hard CC during Stand United's channel cancels the 200s map save — that is the interaction worth the line.
audit.corrected: Cooldown corrected to fourteen seconds; wants.foe[1] rewritten onto Depth Charge cancelling Stand United.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Nautilus's Dredge Line is down.
edits.after: Dredge Line (14s at rank 1) roots you into his passive — trade only inside that fourteen-second gap.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Nautilus must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His full combo lands first: Dredge Line into the passive root into Riptide. Hold the wave your side and give nothing until 4.

edits.before: His only engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only engage, 14s at rank 1 — commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: Stack Duskblade into Locket to amplify his R-to-W chain and blow you up before Ki Barrier absorbs the combo
edits.after: Land Depth Charge to knock you up mid-Stand United, then chain Dredge Line before Ki Barrier absorbs it

edits.before: Levels 4-5 is where the matchup shifts. Your Spirit's Refuge now blocks every passive auto Nautilus fires during an E-taunt, and he has zero dash to escape the blade zone — place W on the blade between you, walk forward, land your Shadow Dash taunt, and all of his autos during the taunt duration vanish into the spirit zone while your Q empowered autos shred him through the blade. His Q is his only range play; once you bait it into a wall or a minion, he is a slow immobile tank with no answer to your trade pattern for the next eight seconds. At level 6 he cannot punish your global — his kit has no way to hard-freeze the wave or burst you under tower in the time Stand United takes to channel, so press R freely.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 is where the matchup shifts. Your Spirit's Refuge now blocks every passive auto Nautilus fires during an E-taunt, and he has zero dash to escape the blade zone — place W on the blade between you, walk forward, land your Shadow Dash taunt, and all of his autos during the taunt duration vanish into the spirit zone while your Q empowered autos shred him through the blade. His Q is his only range play; once you bait it into a wall or a minion, he is a slow immobile tank with no answer to your trade pattern for the next fourteen seconds. At level 6 he cannot punish your global — but Depth Charge knocks you up and cancels Stand United mid-channel, so start it out of his 825 range.

notes: All three packet suspectNames here are false positives — Spirit's Refuge and Stand United are the correct Riot names and the checker fired on the preceding word. wants.foe[1] previously described a Duskblade/Locket Nautilus build that does not exist; replaced with the Depth Charge interrupt on Stand United rather than left as filler.
